scope: QSTARS_TWO_PHOT_J (env) = a QStarS stored-J file (QSTARS_RJ.bin, this model's radius and frequency grid): the two-photon method TWO_METH=USE_RAD is kept in COMP_F=T passes (COMP_OPAC no longer substitutes OLD_DEFAULT) and the conjugate-frequency J of TWO_PHOT_OPAC_V3 is interpolated from that file with the statements of GET_J_FOR_TWO_PHOT (qs_two_phot_get_j) instead of EDDFACTOR. The file is fixed (lagged) data; it is loaded and verified once (qs_two_phot_j_init: QSRJ0001 header, ND, NCF, every FL to 1e-14, J > 0) and any mismatch, INC_TWO=F or TWO_METH /= USE_RAD stops with QSTARS_TWO_PHOT_J_FAILURE. The tangent (qs_jv_freq) follows the module TWO_METHOD of the residual, so its existing non-OLD_DEFAULT branch applies with PHOT_OC_TWO held fixed; code there is unchanged apart from a consistency stop and a QSTARS_JV_STATS line. Unset: the native OLD_DEFAULT substitution and all arithmetic are those of build 31.
